summary: A pinned 343,588,654-byte HRDexDB core pilot now contains ten unique objects with complete human/robot RGB, camera calibration, robot state/tactile timestamps, object pose, and mesh evidence under an object-disjoint split.
evidence: The dataset revision is a46347556efd7ed87e70e7e87293b462d7253d6f with CC-BY-NC-4.0 and non-gated access.
Train objects are apple, attached_container, baby_beaker, balloon_whisk, bamboo_basket, and bamboo_box; validation is banana and beige_brush; sealed test is box_pink and cactus.
All selected robot scenes have grasp_success=true and a frozen paired human episode.

The final A800-4 manifest contains 269 files; 268 were reused by hard link after a transient network failure and one missing calibration file was transferred from the independently verified local copy.
lessons: Successful grasp metadata alone does not guarantee that a scene contains robot raw/video/C2R assets; complete pairs must be explicitly selected and frozen.
Resumable hard-linked caches prevent repeated 300 MB downloads while preserving failed attempts.
limitations: MANO per-frame parameters are not included in this core download.
The dataset is non-commercial and human privacy/personality rights require separate review.
next_actions: Use validation objects only to test raw and geometry/object-factored methods; keep box_pink and cactus sealed until the method and thresholds are frozen.
